description: External callers only: durably send once and await that message's consuming turn. Prefer Codex final_answer text; otherwise last complete assistant text (Claude text blocks joined by newline). Large output is an artifact. Timeout never cancels delivery; resume by message_id. Reuse request_id and identical send arguments after a lost acceptance response. No steer; explicit replies across later turns are not supported. Optional attachments are ordered absolute source paths (max 10), captured at acceptance. Example: {"name":"hive_call","arguments":{"target":"AGENT_ID","body":"Summarize the current diff.","request_id":"summary-1","timeout":45}}

attachments.description: Ordered absolute source paths, up to 10; default empty. Captured when the send is accepted.

items.description: Absolute source path within 1..65536 UTF-8 bytes, without NUL.

body.description: Message body, 1..65536 UTF-8 bytes; newlines are allowed.

mode.description: next-turn (default) or redirect; steer is not supported.

request_id.description: Retry identity, 1..128 UTF-8 bytes without control characters; reuse it with identical send arguments.

timeout.description: Observation timeout in integer seconds, 1..600; default 45. Does not cancel the message.

name: hive_call

description: Resume observation of an external send by its actual message_id, without resending. Bounded timeout stops observation only. Compacted replies may report result_expired. Example: {"name":"hive_wait_message","arguments":{"message_id":"MESSAGE_ID","timeout":45}}

message_id.description: Previously accepted message ID, 1..65536 UTF-8 bytes.

timeout.description: Observation timeout in integer seconds, 1..600; default 45. Does not cancel the message.

name: hive_wait_message

description: Read a bounded UTF-8 page from retained output's immutable artifact. Follow next_offset until eof; the artifact is a JSON payload containing text. Example: {"name":"hive_output","arguments":{"id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","offset":0,"limit":65536}}

id.description: UUID of an output artifact returned by a call result.

limit.description: Maximum UTF-8 page size in bytes, an integer from 4 to 65536; default 65536.

offset.description: Byte offset, an unsigned integer; default 0. Continue using next_offset.

name: hive_output
